To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a data dictionary server based on a semantic representation of information sources.
the object oriented design of a semantic network is a promising approach for automated navigation in a medical data dictionary and that this approach can be used in clinical information systems.

1) the semantic network is represented as a group of objects; 2) the semantic network can be navigated by means of a pathfinding algorithm; 3) the pathfinding algorithm can be used to extract parts of the semantic structure; 4) the pathfinding is independent of a predefined layout of the semantic network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation, and evaluation of the Giessen Data Dictionary as an information infrastructure to support clinical decision making.
the development of an automated navigation system for medical data dictionaries.
the development of a data dictionary server which is able to navigate through a semantic network and to provide the user with relevant information sources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work is a first step towards a data dictionary server which can be used in the context of clinical information systems.
the presented object-oriented design for a semantic network is a very useful tool to implement a medical data dictionary server.
this approach provides the clinician with a flexible, efficient and user-friendly access to all information sources available in the hospital network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Giessen Data Dictionary (GDD) Server is a component of a clinical information system that can be used to present information to the user based on the current topic in a clinical documentation application.
the Giessen Data Dictionary server is a flexible, extensible, and reusable tool for navigation of semantic networks.
we have implemented a data dictionary server that is able to navigate the semantic network of our medical data dictionary.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a data dictionary server is a valuable tool to integrate information sources and to provide the right information at the right time.
the design and implementation of an object-oriented data dictionary server can be used to represent a semantic network in an efficient way.
the Giessen Data Dictionary can be used as a basis for a data dictionary server that can be used in various clinical information systems.
